```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Problem 1:

```{r clean}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
noaa =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(as.character(date),
                   tryFormats = c("%Y-%m-%d", "%Y%m%d")),
    year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")),
    month = as.integer(format(date, "%m")),
    day = as.integer(format(date, "%d")),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp) / 10,
    snow = as.numeric(snow),
    snwd = as.numeric(snwd)
  ) |>
  relocate(year, month, day, .after = date)

noaa |>
  select(id, date, year, month, day, prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, tmin) |>
  glimpse()

noaa_missing =
  noaa |>
  summarise(across(c(prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, tmin),
                   ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") |>
  mutate(pct_missing = round(100 * n_missing / nrow(noaa), 1))

knitr::kable(
  noaa_missing,
  col.names = c("Variable", "Missing observations", "Missing (%)"),
  caption = "Missingness in the five weather measurements"
)
```
The dataset contains `r format(nrow(noaa), big.mark = ",")` station-day observations, `r ncol(noaa)` variables, and `r n_distinct(noaa$id)` distinct weather stations. The main variables are precipitation (`prcp`, mm), snowfall (`snow`, mm), snow depth (`snwd`, mm), maximum temperature (`tmax`, degrees Celsius), and minimum temperature (`tmin`, degrees Celsius).


```{r snowfall}
snow_values =
  noaa |>
  filter(!is.na(snow)) |>
  count(snow, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

knitr::kable(
  snow_values,
  col.names = c("Snowfall (mm)", "Number of observations"),
  caption = "Ten most commonly recorded nonmissing snowfall values"
)
```

The most commonly observed snowfall value is 0 because most days have no snowfall.

## the average max temperature in January and in July
```{r max_temperature}
station_temperatures =
  noaa |>
  filter(month %in% c(1, 7), !is.na(tmax)) |>
  group_by(id, year, month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    n_days = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = c(1, 7),
                   labels = c("January", "July"))
  )

ggplot(station_temperatures,
       aes(x = year, y = mean_tmax)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.18, size = 0.65) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ month, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean maximum temperature at each station, by year",
    subtitle = "Each point represents a station-year-month average",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average daily maximum temperature (°C)"
  )
```

July generally has much higher maximum temperatures than January due to season partern. 


```{r tmax_vs_tmin}
noaa |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 65) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", name = "Observations") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Maximum versus minimum daily temperatures",
    subtitle = "Two-dimensional bin counts avoid overplotting",
    x = "Daily minimum temperature (°C)",
    y = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)"
  )
```


## The distribution of snowfall values greater than 0 and less than 100, by year

```{r p1-snow-distribution}
noaa |>
  filter(!is.na(snow), snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = snow)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.15,
               linewidth = 0.35) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of snowfall on snowy days, by year",
    subtitle = "Only observations with 0 < snowfall < 100 mm",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Daily snowfall (mm)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```
